points.why: It states L(next) = L + 30 − 25 − 0.05·L, with every flow taken from the start-of-week list.
Its values of 119, 118.1, 117.2 and 116.3 match, and it derives the equilibrium of 100 from 30 = 25 + 0.05·100.
It says demand exceeds capacity by 5 a week and that dropouts are the only drain shrinking the list.
It calls the shrinkage a hidden shortfall, names dropouts (about 6 now, 5 at equilibrium) as the flow doing the work, and says to track the share of referrals that get seen.

pitfalls.why: It explicitly says fewer people waiting doesn't mean better access.
